query:
SELECT 
  cc.classificacao,
  cc.divisor,
  SUM(CAST(lc.valor AS DECIMAL(15,2))) as total
FROM lancamento_custo lc
JOIN conta_custo cc ON lc.contaCustoId = cc.id
WHERE lc.periodoCustoId = (SELECT id FROM periodo_custo WHERE mes = 5 AND ano = 2026 LIMIT 1)
GROUP BY cc.classificacao, cc.divisor
ORDER BY cc.classificacao;
